product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI provides professionals and enterprises with an AI super-assistant and platform for using AI models, building AI apps, and deploying agents to automate work.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as an AI super assistant for professionals and enterprises and presents agent-building and app-building capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing information lists ChatLLM plan prices and billing details.

named_customers.notes: The case-studies page uses anonymized customer labels rather than naming its clients. I found one named customer story (1-800-Flowers.com), but not two; the response is empty under the task's fewer-than-two-names rule.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn's 2026 company profile reports approximately 292 employees, within this band.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies San Francisco as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states that it was founded in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains multiple technical research/model posts describing work on model capabilities and implementation, including posts authored by technical staff; this is more than a single engineering-oriented post.

public_docs.notes: The site links to a public Help center containing multiple product documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists an open Research Scientist role focused on generative AI research.

model_provider.notes: Abacus.AI's data-security FAQ says it has enterprise agreements with LLM providers such as these.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names these in its compliance program. GDPR is included because the question asks for named compliance certifications/claims, not only formal certification types.

last_funding.notes: The dated funding announcement reports a $50 million Series C in October 2021; funding databases identify it as the latest round.
